110 |     reg  [15:0] fb_cnt_latch;     // REFCLK 域锁存的计数值
111 | 
112 |     // 中途退出条件: 校准未完成 (非 DONE) 时 LOOP_BREAK 被拉低 (基于同步后 lb_d1)
113 |     wire        abort = (c_st != ST_IDLE) && (c_st != ST_DONE) && (~lb_d1);
114 | 
115 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
116 |     // 0. 复位同步器: REFCLK 域 (异步复位, 同步释放)
117 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
118 |     reg         rst_n_meta_ref;
119 |     reg         rst_n_ref;
120 |     always @(posedge REFCLK or negedge RST_N) begin
121 |         if (!RST_N) begin
122 |             rst_n_meta_ref <= 1'b0;
123 |             rst_n_ref      <= 1'b0;
124 |         end else begin
125 |             rst_n_meta_ref <= 1'b1;
126 |             rst_n_ref      <= rst_n_meta_ref;
127 |         end
128 |     end
129 | 
130 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
131 |     // 0b. 复位同步器: FBCLK 域 (异步复位, 同步释放)
132 |     //     FBCLK 未起振时 rst_n_fb 保持 0, FBCLK 寄存器维持复位态;
133 |     //     FBCLK 起振后 2 拍释放, 安全。与 model initial 行为等价。
134 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
135 |     reg         rst_n_meta_fb;
136 |     reg         rst_n_fb;
137 |     always @(posedge FBCLK or negedge RST_N) begin
138 |         if (!RST_N) begin
139 |             rst_n_meta_fb <= 1'b0;
140 |             rst_n_fb      <= 1'b0;
141 |         end else begin
142 |             rst_n_meta_fb <= 1'b1;
143 |             rst_n_fb      <= rst_n_meta_fb;
144 |         end
145 |     end
146 | 
147 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
148 |     // 1. FSM 状态转移 (下一状态组合逻辑)
149 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
150 |     always @(*) begin
151 |         n_st = c_st;
152 |         case (c_st)
153 |             ST_IDLE: begin
154 |                 if (lb_rise) n_st = ST_START_SETTLE;
155 |             end
156 | 
157 |             ST_START_SETTLE: begin
158 |                 if (abort) n_st = ST_IDLE;
159 |                 else if (settle_cnt >= START_SETTLE) n_st = ST_WIN_COUNT;
160 |             end
161 | 
162 |             ST_WIN_COUNT: begin
163 |                 if (abort) n_st = ST_IDLE;
164 |                 else if (win_cnt >= (WINDOW_LEN - 10'd1)) n_st = ST_CAP_WAIT;
165 |             end
166 | 
167 |             ST_CAP_WAIT: begin
168 |                 if (abort) n_st = ST_IDLE;
169 |                 else if (cap_wait_cnt >= GATE_SYNC_DLY) n_st = ST_DECIDE;
170 |             end
171 | 
172 |             ST_DECIDE: begin
173 |                 // 判定后立即转移 (纯判定状态, 组合读 fb_cnt_latch)
174 |                 if (fb_cnt_latch > THRESHOLD) begin
175 |                     // 频率偏高
176 |                     if (vcode == 4'd15) n_st = ST_DONE;       // 已到最大值, 锁定完成
177 |                     else                n_st = ST_CAP_SETTLE;  // +1 后继续
178 |                 end else begin
179 |                     // 达标 -> 直接完成 (无稳定复验, 与 model 的 STABLE_CNT 机制不同)
180 |                     n_st = ST_DONE;
181 |                 end
182 |             end
183 | 
184 |             ST_CAP_SETTLE: begin
185 |                 if (abort) n_st = ST_IDLE;
186 |                 else if (settle_cnt >= CAP_SETTLE) n_st = ST_WIN_COUNT;
187 |             end
188 | 
189 |             ST_DONE: begin
190 |                 if (lb_rise) n_st = ST_START_SETTLE;  // 重新触发
191 |                 // LOOP_BREAK 拉低时保持 DONE (calib_done 锁存, vcode 保持)
192 |             end
193 | 
194 |             default: n_st = ST_IDLE;
195 |         endcase
196 |     end
197 | 
198 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
199 |     // 2. FSM 状态寄存器 + 数据通路更新 (REFCLK 域, 异步复位)
200 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
201 |     always @(posedge REFCLK or negedge rst_n_ref) begin
202 |         if (!rst_n_ref) begin
203 |             c_st           <= ST_IDLE;
204 |             win_cnt        <= 10'd0;
205 |             settle_cnt     <= 10'd0;
206 |             cap_wait_cnt   <= 4'd0;
207 |             calib_done     <= 1'b0;
208 |             vcode          <= 4'd0;
209 |             fb_cnt_latch   <= 16'd0;
210 |         end else begin
211 |             c_st <= n_st;
212 | 
213 |             // LOOP_BREAK 上升沿: 校准复位点 (优先级最高)
214 |             if (lb_rise) begin
215 |                 vcode        <= 4'd0;
216 |                 calib_done   <= 1'b0;
217 |                 win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
218 |                 settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
219 |                 cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
220 |             end else if (abort) begin
221 |                 // 中途退出: 放弃本次, VCODE 归 0, 回 IDLE
222 |                 vcode        <= 4'd0;
223 |                 calib_done   <= 1'b0;
224 |                 win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
225 |                 settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
226 |                 cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
227 |             end else begin
228 |                 case (c_st)
229 |                     ST_IDLE: begin
230 |                         // 保持 (vcode/calib_done 由 DONE 进入或重新触发控制)
231 |                         win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
232 |                         settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
233 |                         cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
234 |                     end
235 | 
236 |                     ST_START_SETTLE: begin
237 |                         if (settle_cnt >= START_SETTLE) begin
238 |                             settle_cnt <= 10'd0;
239 |                             win_cnt    <= 10'd0;
240 |                         end else begin
241 |                             settle_cnt <= settle_cnt + 10'd1;
242 |                         end
243 |                     end
244 | 
245 |                     ST_WIN_COUNT: begin
246 |                         if (win_cnt >= (WINDOW_LEN - 10'd1)) begin
247 |                             win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
248 |                             cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;  // 进入 CAP_WAIT 前清
249 |                         end else begin
250 |                             win_cnt <= win_cnt + 10'd1;
251 |                         end
252 |                     end
253 | 
254 |                     ST_CAP_WAIT: begin
255 |                         // 等待 FBCLK 域同步 gate=0, 然后锁存 fb_cnt
256 |                         if (cap_wait_cnt >= GATE_SYNC_DLY) begin
257 |                             fb_cnt_latch <= fb_cnt;   // 读已稳定的 FBCLK 域计数值
258 |                             cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
259 |                         end else begin
260 |                             cap_wait_cnt <= cap_wait_cnt + 4'd1;
261 |                         end
262 |                     end
263 | 
264 |                     ST_DECIDE: begin
265 |                         // 判定动作 (状态转移在组合逻辑, 此处更新数据通路)
266 |                         // 频率偏高: vcode+1 (若 vcode==15 保持, 锁定)
267 |                         // 达标:     vcode 保持, 状态机直达 ST_DONE (无稳定复验)
268 |                         if (fb_cnt_latch > THRESHOLD) begin
269 |                             if (vcode != 4'd15) vcode <= vcode + 4'd1;
270 |                         end
271 |                         win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
272 |                         settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
273 |                         cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
274 |                     end
275 | 
276 |                     ST_CAP_SETTLE: begin
277 |                         if (settle_cnt >= CAP_SETTLE) begin
278 |                             settle_cnt <= 10'd0;
279 |                             win_cnt    <= 10'd0;
280 |                         end else begin
281 |                             settle_cnt <= settle_cnt + 10'd1;
282 |                         end
283 |                     end
284 | 
285 |                     ST_DONE: begin
286 |                         calib_done <= 1'b1;   // 锁存完成标志
287 |                         // vcode 保持 (校准结果)
288 |                     end
289 | 
290 |                     default: begin
291 |                         win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
292 |                         settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
293 |                         cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
294 |                     end
295 |                 endcase
296 |             end
297 |         end
298 |     end
299 | 
300 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
301 |     // 2b. LOOP_BREAK 同步 (REFCLK 域, 异步复位)
302 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
303 |     always @(posedge REFCLK or negedge rst_n_ref) begin
304 |         if (!rst_n_ref) begin
305 |             lb_d1 <= 1'b0;
306 |             lb_d2 <= 1'b0;
307 |         end else begin
308 |             lb_d1 <= LOOP_BREAK;
309 |             lb_d2 <= lb_d1;
310 |         end
311 |     end
312 | 
313 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
314 |     // 3. FBCLK 域: gate 同步器 + 脉冲计数器 (异步复位 rst_n_fb)
315 |     // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
316 |     always @(posedge FBCLK or negedge rst_n_fb) begin
317 |         if (!rst_n_fb) begin

337 |     end
338 |

```makefile
#==============================================================

#==============================================================

SCRIPT_REPO  = /apps/imctf/cad/script/digital_flow/feint
ROOT_DIR     = $(shell pwd)
SCRIPT_DIR   = $(ROOT_DIR)/scripts
WORK_DIR     = $(ROOT_DIR)/flow_$(DESIGN)

#---------Project Config---------
DESIGN        = cfreq_ctrl
RTL_FILELIST  = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/syn_filelist.f
RTL_SOURCE_FORMAT = verilog
# gate2gate 模式下的参考网表 (由布局/优化前网表充当参考)
FM_REF_NETLIST   = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/netlist/$(DESIGN).mapped.v
# rtl2gate 模式下的实现网表 (综合后门级网表)
FM_IMPL_NETLIST  = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/netlist/$(DESIGN).mapped.v
SVF_FILE      = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/$(DESIGN).svf
PROJECT_HOME  = $(ROOT_DIR)/../
TAG           ?= Au22

FM_DONE       = $(WORK_DIR)/results/fm.done

#---------Tool Config---------
USE_LSF        ?= 1
LSF_QUEUE      ?= fqueue2h
MODULE_FM      ?= ds/fm/2023.12-SP5
FM_BIN         ?= $(shell command -v fm_shell 2>/dev/null || echo /apps/synopsys/SRB/formality/V-2023.12-SP5/bin/fm_shell)

# fm.tcl 变量透传 (与 lagat Makefile -x 接口一致)
FM_XARGS = set DESIGN $(DESIGN); set cur_date $(TAG); \
           set RTL_FILELIST $(RTL_FILELIST); \
           set RTL_SOURCE_FORMAT $(RTL_SOURCE_FORMAT); \
           set ROOT_DIR $(ROOT_DIR); \
           set FM_MODE $(FM_MODE); \
           set FM_REF_NETLIST $(FM_REF_NETLIST); \
           set FM_IMPL_NETLIST $(FM_IMPL_NETLIST); \
           set SVF_FILE $(SVF_FILE); set PROJECT_HOME $(PROJECT_HOME)

# 从 filelist 提取 RTL 源文件绝对路径, 作为 fm.done 依赖
RTL_FILES = $(addprefix $(dir $(RTL_FILELIST)), \
            $(filter-out +incdir% +define% -F% -f% -v% -y% //%, \
              $(strip $(file <$(RTL_FILELIST)))))

ifeq ($(USE_LSF),1)
  define RUN
	bsub -Is \
		-q $(LSF_QUEUE) \
		"module purge && module load $(MODULE_FM) && \
		 cd $(WORK_DIR) && \
		 fm_shell -f $(SCRIPT_DIR)/fm.tcl -x '$(FM_XARGS)' \
		 | tee logs/fm_$(FM_MODE).log && \
		 touch $(FM_DONE)"
  endef
else
  define RUN
	bash -c "set -o pipefail; cd $(WORK_DIR) && \
		 $(FM_BIN) -f $(SCRIPT_DIR)/fm.tcl -x '$(FM_XARGS)' \
		 2>&1 | tee logs/fm_$(FM_MODE).log && \
		 touch $(FM_DONE)"
  endef
endif

.PHONY: all fm_r2g fm_g2g clean distclean

all: fm_r2g

$(WORK_DIR):
	@mkdir -p $(WORK_DIR)/logs $(WORK_DIR)/reports $(WORK_DIR)/results

fm_r2g:

fm_g2g:

_do_fm: $(FM_DONE)

$(FM_DONE): $(RTL_FILELIST) $(FM_IMPL_NETLIST) $(SCRIPT_DIR)/fm.tcl $(SCRIPT_DIR)/fm_setup.tcl $(RTL_FILES) | $(WORK_DIR)
	@echo ">> Running Formality $(FM_MODE) verification for $(DESIGN) (USE_LSF=$(USE_LSF))..."
	$(call RUN, $(DESIGN)_fm)
	@echo ">> Formality verified: $(FM_DONE)"

clean:

	       $(WORK_DIR)/*.db $(WORK_DIR)/command.log $(WORK_DIR)/WORK \
	       $(WORK_DIR)/formality_run

distclean: clean
	rm -rf $(WORK_DIR)
```

```tcl
    report_setup_status preverify match verify save_session redirect exit
    redirect report_unmatched_points report_failing_points report_aborted analyze_points
```

```
//####################################################
// Description
//####################################################
// Revision History
//  -v1.0  Lorik Xiao  2026-10-19
//      Initial version
//  -v1.1  Lorik Xiao  2026-10-23
//      WINDOW_LEN/THRESHOLD 改为 10bit 输入端口; 删除稳定复验(STABLE_CNT);
//      START_SETTLE 改 10bit; CAP_SETTLE/GATE_SYNC_DLY 改 4bit
//####################################################

// ============================================================================
// cfreq_ctrl.v
// VCO 自动校准模块 (Synthesizable RTL, Verilog-2001)
//
// 功能: 固定 Vctrl=1/2 VDD, 通过单向递增电容阵列码将 VCO 输出校准到 ~10GHz
//       (FBCLK≈25MHz)。采用门控窗法在 REFCLK 域生成使能窗, 用 FBCLK 作计数
//       时钟在窗内统计脉冲数, 窗关闭后 REFCLK 域读值判定。
//
// 本文件为可综合版本。基于 behavior model (../rtl/cfreq_ctrl.v) 改造,
// 与 model 的差异点见下方"改造点"。
// 改造点:
//   - 新增 RST_N 复位端口 (低有效, 异步复位 + 同步释放)
//   - 删除 initial 块 (不可综合)
//   - REFCLK 域 / FBCLK 域各自 2 级同步释放复位
//   - 所有寄存器加异步复位分支, 复位值 = model initial 值
//   - WINDOW_LEN / THRESHOLD 改为外部输入端口 (10bit), 由上层或 TB 配置
//   - 删除稳定复验机制 (STABLE_CNT/stable_cnt/stable_phase):
//     单窗达标 (fb_cnt_latch <= THRESHOLD) 即进 DONE 拉 RDY
//
// Features:
//   - 单向递增搜索: VCODE 从 0 起步, 频率偏高则 +1, 达标则停止
//   - 门控窗计数 (CDC 简化法): REFCLK 域 gate, FBCLK 域同步后计数
//   - 达标即完成: 窗内 FBCLK 计数 <= THRESHOLD 直接拉 RDY (无稳定复验)
//   - LOOP_BREAK 上升沿为校准复位点, 可重新触发
//   - 边界: code=0 已达标保持 0; code=15 仍未达标保持 15 并拉 RDY
//   - 中途退出 (RDY 未高时 LB 拉低): 放弃本次, VCODE 归 0
//   - 复位后: RDY=0, CAP_CTRL_OUT=0, 所有寄存器归零 (与 model 上电等价)
//
// Version: 1.1-synth
// Changelog (v1.1-synth):
//   - WINDOW_LEN/THRESHOLD 由 parameter 改为 10bit 输入端口
//   - 删除 STABLE_CNT 稳定复验: 达标即 RDY
//   - START_SETTLE 位宽 16->10bit; CAP_SETTLE/GATE_SYNC_DLY 位宽 16/8->4bit
// Changelog (v1.0-synth):
//   - 基于 v1.0 model 改造为可综合 RTL, 新增 RST_N, 删除 initial
//
// ============================================================================

`timescale 1ns/1ps

module cfreq_ctrl (
    input  wire        REFCLK,        // 25MHz - 100MHz 参考时钟         
    input  wire        FBCLK,         // VCO 输出 divider 分频后的反馈时钟
    input  wire        LOOP_BREAK,    // 上升沿=启动校准/复位点; 拉低=正常模式        
    input  wire        RST_N,         // 异步复位 (低有效), 同步释放
    input  wire [9:0]  WINDOW_LEN,    // 比对窗口长度 (REFCLK 周期数, 10bit 外部输入)
    input  wire [9:0]  THRESHOLD,     // 停止阈值: FBCLK 计数<=此值即达标 (10bit, 通常=WINDOW_LEN)
    output reg         RDY,           // 校准完成标志
    output reg  [4:0]  CAP_CTRL_OUT   // 电容控制码, bit[4]恒0, 有效码 0~15
);

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Parameters (WINDOW_LEN/THRESHOLD 已改为 10bit 输入端口, 见端口列表;
    //             STABLE_CNT 稳定复验机制已删除, 达标即 RDY)
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    parameter [9:0]  START_SETTLE   = 10'd64;    // 启动后 VCO 起振等待 (REFCLK 周期)
    parameter [3:0]  CAP_SETTLE     = 4'd4;      // 每次 +1 后电容稳定等待 (REFCLK 周期)
    parameter [3:0]  GATE_SYNC_DLY  = 4'd4;      // CAP_WAIT 等待 FBCLK 域同步 gate=0 的拍数

    // 注: gate 高电平 = WINDOW_LEN 个 REFCLK 周期 (不做长度补偿), WINDOW_LEN/THRESHOLD
    //     由外部输入配置; fb_cnt ≈ WINDOW_LEN*(FBCLK_freq/REFCLK_freq), CDC ±1 误差
    //     可接受; THRESHOLD 通常配置为与 WINDOW_LEN 同值 (目标 FBCLK≈REFCLK)

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // FSM States
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    localparam [3:0]
        ST_IDLE         = 4'd0,   // 等待 LOOP_BREAK 上升沿
        ST_START_SETTLE = 4'd1,   // 启动后等待 VCO 起振
        ST_WIN_COUNT    = 4'd2,   // 比对窗口计数 (gate=1)
        ST_CAP_WAIT     = 4'd3,   // 窗口结束, 等待 FBCLK 域同步 gate=0
        ST_DECIDE       = 4'd4,   // 判定: 达标/偏高/边界
        ST_CAP_SETTLE   = 4'd5,   // VCODE+1 后电容稳定等待
        ST_DONE         = 4'd6;   // 校准完成, RDY=1

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Registers & Wires
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    reg  [3:0]  c_st, n_st;
    reg  [9:0]  win_cnt;          // REFCLK 域窗口计数器 (WINDOW_LEN 10bit)
    reg  [9:0]  settle_cnt;       // 通用 settle 计数器 (START/CAP, START_SETTLE 10bit)
    reg  [3:0]  cap_wait_cnt;     // CAP_WAIT 等待计数器 (GATE_SYNC_DLY 4bit)
    reg         calib_done;       // 校准已完成标志 (DONE 后保持)
    reg  [3:0]  vcode;            // 电容控制码 (有效 0~15)

    // LOOP_BREAK 上升沿检测 (REFCLK 域, 两级同步寄存器化, posedge 沿稳定)
    reg         lb_d1;
    reg         lb_d2;
    wire        lb_rise = lb_d1 & ~lb_d2;   // 寄存器化脉冲, 避免组合竞争

    // gate 使能 (REFCLK 域, 组合产生, 跟随寄存器状态无毛刺)
    wire        gate    = (c_st == ST_WIN_COUNT);

    // FBCLK 域: gate 同步器 + 脉冲计数器
    reg         gate_sync_meta;
    reg         gate_sync;
    reg         gate_sync_prev;   // 用于检测 gate_sync 上升沿 (清 fb_cnt)
    reg  [15:0] fb_cnt;           // FBCLK 域脉冲计数器
    reg  [15:0] fb_cnt_latch;     // REFCLK 域锁存的计数值

    // 中途退出条件: 校准未完成 (非 DONE) 时 LOOP_BREAK 被拉低 (基于同步后 lb_d1)
    wire        abort = (c_st != ST_IDLE) && (c_st != ST_DONE) && (~lb_d1);

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0. 复位同步器: REFCLK 域 (异步复位, 同步释放)
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    reg         rst_n_meta_ref;
    reg         rst_n_ref;
    always @(posedge REFCLK or negedge RST_N) begin
        if (!RST_N) begin
            rst_n_meta_ref <= 1'b0;
            rst_n_ref      <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            rst_n_meta_ref <= 1'b1;
            rst_n_ref      <= rst_n_meta_ref;
        end
    end

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 0b. 复位同步器: FBCLK 域 (异步复位, 同步释放)
    //     FBCLK 未起振时 rst_n_fb 保持 0, FBCLK 寄存器维持复位态;
    //     FBCLK 起振后 2 拍释放, 安全。与 model initial 行为等价。
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    reg         rst_n_meta_fb;
    reg         rst_n_fb;
    always @(posedge FBCLK or negedge RST_N) begin
        if (!RST_N) begin
            rst_n_meta_fb <= 1'b0;
            rst_n_fb      <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            rst_n_meta_fb <= 1'b1;
            rst_n_fb      <= rst_n_meta_fb;
        end
    end

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. FSM 状态转移 (下一状态组合逻辑)
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    always @(*) begin
        n_st = c_st;
        case (c_st)
            ST_IDLE: begin
                if (lb_rise) n_st = ST_START_SETTLE;
            end

            ST_START_SETTLE: begin
                if (abort) n_st = ST_IDLE;
                else if (settle_cnt >= START_SETTLE) n_st = ST_WIN_COUNT;
            end

            ST_WIN_COUNT: begin
                if (abort) n_st = ST_IDLE;
                else if (win_cnt >= (WINDOW_LEN - 10'd1)) n_st = ST_CAP_WAIT;
            end

            ST_CAP_WAIT: begin
                if (abort) n_st = ST_IDLE;
                else if (cap_wait_cnt >= GATE_SYNC_DLY) n_st = ST_DECIDE;
            end

            ST_DECIDE: begin
                // 判定后立即转移 (纯判定状态, 组合读 fb_cnt_latch)
                if (fb_cnt_latch > THRESHOLD) begin
                    // 频率偏高
                    if (vcode == 4'd15) n_st = ST_DONE;       // 已到最大值, 锁定完成
                    else                n_st = ST_CAP_SETTLE;  // +1 后继续
                end else begin
                    // 达标 -> 直接完成 (无稳定复验, 与 model 的 STABLE_CNT 机制不同)
                    n_st = ST_DONE;
                end
            end

            ST_CAP_SETTLE: begin
                if (abort) n_st = ST_IDLE;
                else if (settle_cnt >= CAP_SETTLE) n_st = ST_WIN_COUNT;
            end

            ST_DONE: begin
                if (lb_rise) n_st = ST_START_SETTLE;  // 重新触发
                // LOOP_BREAK 拉低时保持 DONE (calib_done 锁存, vcode 保持)
            end

            default: n_st = ST_IDLE;
        endcase
    end

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. FSM 状态寄存器 + 数据通路更新 (REFCLK 域, 异步复位)
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    always @(posedge REFCLK or negedge rst_n_ref) begin
        if (!rst_n_ref) begin
            c_st           <= ST_IDLE;
            win_cnt        <= 10'd0;
            settle_cnt     <= 10'd0;
            cap_wait_cnt   <= 4'd0;
            calib_done     <= 1'b0;
            vcode          <= 4'd0;
            fb_cnt_latch   <= 16'd0;
        end else begin
            c_st <= n_st;

            // LOOP_BREAK 上升沿: 校准复位点 (优先级最高)
            if (lb_rise) begin
                vcode        <= 4'd0;
                calib_done   <= 1'b0;
                win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
                settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
                cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
            end else if (abort) begin
                // 中途退出: 放弃本次, VCODE 归 0, 回 IDLE
                vcode        <= 4'd0;
                calib_done   <= 1'b0;
                win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
                settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
                cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                case (c_st)
                    ST_IDLE: begin
                        // 保持 (vcode/calib_done 由 DONE 进入或重新触发控制)
                        win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
                        settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
                        cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
                    end

                    ST_START_SETTLE: begin
                        if (settle_cnt >= START_SETTLE) begin
                            settle_cnt <= 10'd0;
                            win_cnt    <= 10'd0;
                        end else begin
                            settle_cnt <= settle_cnt + 10'd1;
                        end
                    end

                    ST_WIN_COUNT: begin
                        if (win_cnt >= (WINDOW_LEN - 10'd1)) begin
                            win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
                            cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;  // 进入 CAP_WAIT 前清
                        end else begin
                            win_cnt <= win_cnt + 10'd1;
                        end
                    end

                    ST_CAP_WAIT: begin
                        // 等待 FBCLK 域同步 gate=0, 然后锁存 fb_cnt
                        if (cap_wait_cnt >= GATE_SYNC_DLY) begin
                            fb_cnt_latch <= fb_cnt;   // 读已稳定的 FBCLK 域计数值
                            cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
                        end else begin
                            cap_wait_cnt <= cap_wait_cnt + 4'd1;
                        end
                    end

                    ST_DECIDE: begin
                        // 判定动作 (状态转移在组合逻辑, 此处更新数据通路)
                        // 频率偏高: vcode+1 (若 vcode==15 保持, 锁定)
                        // 达标:     vcode 保持, 状态机直达 ST_DONE (无稳定复验)
                        if (fb_cnt_latch > THRESHOLD) begin
                            if (vcode != 4'd15) vcode <= vcode + 4'd1;
                        end
                        win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
                        settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
                        cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
                    end

                    ST_CAP_SETTLE: begin
                        if (settle_cnt >= CAP_SETTLE) begin
                            settle_cnt <= 10'd0;
                            win_cnt    <= 10'd0;
                        end else begin
                            settle_cnt <= settle_cnt + 10'd1;
                        end
                    end

                    ST_DONE: begin
                        calib_done <= 1'b1;   // 锁存完成标志
                        // vcode 保持 (校准结果)
                    end

                    default: begin
                        win_cnt      <= 10'd0;
                        settle_cnt   <= 10'd0;
                        cap_wait_cnt <= 4'd0;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    end

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2b. LOOP_BREAK 同步 (REFCLK 域, 异步复位)
    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    always @(posedge REFCLK or negedge rst_n_ref) begin
        if (!rst_n_ref) begin
```

```systemverilog
//==============================================================
// tb_cfreq_ctrl.sv - CFREQ_CTRL 定向测试台 (代码覆盖率用)
//
// 策略: 固定 REFCLK=25MHz, 通过不同 FBCLK 频率分别覆盖
//   - FBCLK 偏低(计数<=阈值): 首窗达标 -> ST_IDLE..ST_DONE
//   - FBCLK 偏高(计数>阈值):   逐级 VCODE+1 -> ST_CAP_SETTLE 循环
//   - 中途 LOOP_BREAK 拉低:    触发 abort 回 IDLE
// 导出 VCD 供波形/覆盖率查看。
//==============================================================
`timescale 1ns/1ps

module tb_cfreq_ctrl;

    reg         REFCLK, FBCLK, LOOP_BREAK, RST_N;
    reg  [9:0]  WINDOW_LEN, THRESHOLD;
    wire        RDY;
    wire [4:0]  CAP_CTRL_OUT;

    localparam CLK_HALF = 20;  // 25MHz

    cfreq_ctrl dut (
        .REFCLK      (REFCLK),
        .FBCLK       (FBCLK),
        .LOOP_BREAK  (LOOP_BREAK),
        .RST_N       (RST_N),
        .WINDOW_LEN  (WINDOW_LEN),
        .THRESHOLD   (THRESHOLD),
        .RDY         (RDY),
        .CAP_CTRL_OUT(CAP_CTRL_OUT)
    );

    // REFCLK 25MHz
    initial begin
        REFCLK = 1'b0;
        forever #CLK_HALF REFCLK = ~REFCLK;
    end

    // FBCLK 可调: 用整数分频系数逼近不同频率
    real fb_div = 1.0;   // FBCLK = REFCLK / fb_div (fb_div <1 => 更快)
    initial begin
        FBCLK = 1'b0;
        forever begin
            #(CLK_HALF * fb_div) FBCLK = ~FBCLK;
        end
    end

    // 简单 VCD 导出
    initial begin
        $dumpfile("tb_cfreq_ctrl.vcd");
        $dumpvars(0, tb_cfreq_ctrl);
    end

    initial begin
        RST_N      = 1'b0;
        LOOP_BREAK = 1'b0;
        WINDOW_LEN = 10'd16;
        THRESHOLD  = 10'd16;
        fb_div     = 1.0;

        // 复位释放
        repeat (10) @(posedge REFCLK);
        RST_N = 1'b1;
        repeat (10) @(posedge REFCLK);

        // 场景1: FBCLK == REFCLK => 首窗达标, 较快 DONE
        fb_div = 1.0;
        @(posedge REFCLK);
        LOOP_BREAK = 1'b1;
        wait (RDY === 1'b1);
        $display("[TB] scenario1 done: CAP_CTRL_OUT=%0d", CAP_CTRL_OUT);
        LOOP_BREAK = 1'b0;
        repeat (20) @(posedge REFCLK);

        // 场景2: FBCLK 更快(计数偏高) => 触发 VCODE 递增
        fb_div = 0.25;   // FBCLK = 100MHz
        @(posedge REFCLK);
        LOOP_BREAK = 1'b1;
        repeat (4000) @(posedge REFCLK);
        LOOP_BREAK = 1'b0;
        repeat (10) @(posedge REFCLK);

        // 场景3: 中途退出 (校准未完成即拉低 LB)
        fb_div = 0.25;
        @(posedge REFCLK);
        LOOP_BREAK = 1'b1;
        repeat (50) @(posedge REFCLK);
        LOOP_BREAK = 1'b0;   // abort
        repeat (20) @(posedge REFCLK);

        $display("[TB] simulation finished, RDY=%b CAP=%0d", RDY, CAP_CTRL_OUT);
        $finish;
    end

    // 看门狗: 防止死循环
    initial begin
        #1000000;  // 1ms
        $display("[TB] timeout watchdog triggered");
        $finish;
    end

endmodule
```

RTL_FILELIST      = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/syn_filelist.f
FM_REF_NETLIST    = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/netlist/$(DESIGN).mapped.v
FM_IMPL_NETLIST   = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/netlist/$(DESIGN).mapped.v
SVF_FILE          = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/$(DESIGN).svf
PROJECT_HOME      = $(ROOT_DIR)/../
TAG              ?= Au22

#---------Tool Config---------
USE_LSF    ?= 1
LSF_QUEUE  ?= fqueue2h
MODULE_FM  ?= ds/fm/2023.12-SP5
FM_BIN     ?= $(shell command -v fm_shell 2>/dev/null || echo /apps/synopsys/SRB/formality/V-2023.12-SP5/bin/fm_shell)

# fm.tcl 变量透传 (与 lagat Makefile -x 接口一致)
FM_XARGS = set DESIGN $(DESIGN); set cur_date $(TAG); \
           set RTL_FILELIST $(RTL_FILELIST); \
           set ROOT_DIR $(ROOT_DIR); set FM_MODE $(FM_MODE); \
           set FM_REF_NETLIST $(FM_REF_NETLIST); \
           set FM_IMPL_NETLIST $(FM_IMPL_NETLIST); \
           set SVF_FILE $(SVF_FILE); set PROJECT_HOME $(PROJECT_HOME)

# 从 filelist 提取 RTL 源文件作为参考设计依赖 (syn 流程同款实现)
RTL_FILES = $(addprefix $(dir $(RTL_FILELIST)), \
            $(filter-out +incdir% +define% -F% -f% -v% -y% //%, \
              $(strip $(file <$(RTL_FILELIST)))))

FM_R2G_DONE = $(WORK_DIR)/results/fm_r2g.done
FM_G2G_DONE = $(WORK_DIR)/results/fm_g2g.done

ifeq ($(USE_LSF),1)
  RUN_CMD = bsub -Is -q $(LSF_QUEUE) "module purge && module load $(MODULE_FM) && cd $(WORK_DIR) && fm_shell -f $(SCRIPT_DIR)/fm.tcl -x '$(FM_XARGS)' | tee logs/fm_$(FM_MODE).log && touch $@"
else
  RUN_CMD = bash -c "set -o pipefail; cd $(WORK_DIR) && $(FM_BIN) -f $(SCRIPT_DIR)/fm.tcl -x '$(FM_XARGS)' 2>&1 | tee logs/fm_$(FM_MODE).log && touch $@"
endif

.PHONY: all fm_r2g fm_g2g report clean distclean

all: fm_r2g

$(WORK_DIR):
	@mkdir -p $(WORK_DIR)/logs $(WORK_DIR)/reports $(WORK_DIR)/results

fm_r2g: $(FM_R2G_DONE)
fm_g2g: $(FM_G2G_DONE)

$(FM_R2G_DONE): FM_MODE := rtl2gate
$(FM_G2G_DONE): FM_MODE := gate2gate

$(FM_R2G_DONE) $(FM_G2G_DONE): $(RTL_FILELIST) $(FM_REF_NETLIST) $(FM_IMPL_NETLIST) $(SCRIPT_DIR)/fm.tcl $(ROOT_DIR)/setup/common_setup.tcl $(RTL_FILES) | $(WORK_DIR)
	@echo ">> Running Formality ($(FM_MODE)) for $(DESIGN) (USE_LSF=$(USE_LSF))..."
	$(RUN_CMD)
	@echo ">> Formality ($(FM_MODE)) done: $@"

report: | $(WORK_DIR)
	@grep -E "Verification (SUCCEEDED|FAILED|INCONCLUSIVE)|Failing Points" $(WORK_DIR)/reports/*.rpt 2>/dev/null || echo "no fmv report"

clean:
	rm -rf $(WORK_DIR)/results $(WORK_DIR)/reports $(WORK_DIR)/logs \
	       $(WORK_DIR)/*.db $(WORK_DIR)/command.log $(WORK_DIR)/WORK

distclean: clean
	rm -rf $(WORK_DIR)

#==============================================================
# CFREQ_CTRL VCS 代码覆盖率检查流程
# 参考: lagat_flow_ref/syn/Makefile (lagat FEINT 流程结构), 工具换成 VCS + URG
#
# 用法 (在 cov/ 目录下):
#   make cov                      # VCS 编译 + 仿真 + URG 覆盖率报告 (默认)
#   make cov METRICS="line+cond+tgl+fsm+branch"
#   make cov USE_LSF=0            # 本地直跑 (不走 LSF)
#   make report / clean / distclean
#
# 产出 (flow_cfreq_ctrl/):
#   vdb/simv.vdb/                  (VCS coverage database)
#   reports/cfreq_ctrl.urgReport/  (URG HTML/文本报告)
#   logs/{vcs_compile,vcs_sim,urg}.log
#==============================================================

ROOT_DIR     = $(shell pwd)
SCRIPT_DIR   = $(ROOT_DIR)/scripts
WORK_DIR     = $(ROOT_DIR)/flow_$(DESIGN)

#---------Project Config---------
DESIGN       = cfreq_ctrl
RTL_FILELIST = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/syn_filelist.f
TB           = $(ROOT_DIR)/data/tb_$(DESIGN).sv
COV_METRICS ?= line+cond+tgl+fsm+branch
TAG         ?= Au22

#---------Tool Config---------
USE_LSF    ?= 0
LSF_QUEUE  ?= fqueue2h
MODULE_COV ?= vcs/vcs_mx/2023.12-SP2

# cov.tcl 变量透传 (argv)
COV_ARGS = -design $(DESIGN) -rtl $(RTL_FILELIST) -tb $(TB) -metrics $(COV_METRICS) -workdir $(WORK_DIR) -tag $(TAG)

COV_DONE = $(WORK_DIR)/cov.done

ifeq ($(USE_LSF),1)
  RUN_CMD = bsub -Is -q $(LSF_QUEUE) "module purge && module load $(MODULE_COV) && tclsh $(SCRIPT_DIR)/cov.tcl $(COV_ARGS) | tee logs/cov.log && touch $@"
else
  RUN_CMD = bash -c "set -o pipefail; tclsh $(SCRIPT_DIR)/cov.tcl $(COV_ARGS) 2>&1 | tee logs/cov.log && touch $@"
endif

.PHONY: all cov report clean distclean

all: cov

$(WORK_DIR):
	@mkdir -p $(WORK_DIR)/logs $(WORK_DIR)/reports $(WORK_DIR)/vdb

cov: $(COV_DONE)

$(COV_DONE): $(RTL_FILELIST) $(TB) $(SCRIPT_DIR)/cov.tcl $(ROOT_DIR)/setup/common_setup.tcl | $(WORK_DIR)
	@echo ">> Running VCS coverage for $(DESIGN) (metrics=$(COV_METRICS))..."
	$(RUN_CMD)
	@echo ">> Coverage done: $@"

report: | $(WORK_DIR)
	@ls -d $(WORK_DIR)/reports/*.urgReport 2>/dev/null || echo "no coverage report; run: make cov"

clean:
	rm -rf $(WORK_DIR)/vdb $(WORK_DIR)/reports $(WORK_DIR)/logs \
	       $(WORK_DIR)/csrc $(WORK_DIR)/simv* $(WORK_DIR)/*.vdb $(WORK_DIR)/*.log \
	       $(WORK_DIR)/*.vcd

distclean: clean
	rm -rf $(WORK_DIR)
